description: Baselines for the XCTest performance suite (#73) on one machine type; see docs/performance.md.

recorded.note: GitHub Actions xcode-27 runner (Apple silicon VM), iPhone 17 simulator, iOS 27.0, Release with BLAU_PERF; CI run 37674414639

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_ApplicationLaunch.name: Duration (AppLaunch)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_ApplicationLaunch.note: Launch time on the shared CI VMs moves by a third between runs on different hosts (median 7.30 s on the 2026-10-07 nightly, 4.68 s here), so only a gross regression trips it; the device numbers are the launch baseline that matters (docs/performance.md).

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.name: Memory Physical (blau)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_Memory-com.joebla.note: The memory a session leaves behind: a few hundred kB either way, so changes under 2 MB are noise.

com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_OSSignpost-db.sav.name: Duration (db.save)
com.apple.dt.XCTMetric_OSSignpost-db.sav.note: XCTOSSignpostMetric reports one interval per iteration, not the session's total, so it swings far more than 10% between runs; gated only against gross regressions. The session's CPU and memory metrics carry the 10% gate.
